# Journal — a knife found by the scenic route

Malcolm, still in The Reeds, tried "look in the stalks" (unparsed —
nothing recognized that phrase), then tried "search" (took it, no
complaint logged), then tried "look at metal" — which hit, firing the
`reeds-knife` interaction and picking up a flint knife. Equipped it,
looked around, walked north back to The Creek.

This is the good version of an unanswered command: someone hunting for
a known object by feel, missing once, and finding the right phrasing on
their own three tries later, all within about 18 seconds. No fix
needed — the interaction was reachable, just not on the first guess.
I'm resisting the urge to add "stalks" as a synonym for the knife
trigger off one miss; if it comes up again from someone else, that's a
real pattern rather than one person's first phrasing.

Malcolm now has a flint knife equipped and is walking back toward the
loop's more dangerous ground. Nothing broken, nobody hurt. Letting it
be.
